purpose.domain_detail: Retail banking demonstration system - account balance display screen (screen 30)
purpose.summary: BBANK30P is the business logic layer program for displaying account balances in a Micro Focus demonstration banking application. It handles screen navigation (PF keys), help screen activation, and service charge estimation based on account balance bands. It operates as part of a multi-screen CICS-style application passing data via DFHCOMMAREA.

notable_features: COPY CENTRY (Micro Focus entry point copybook)
Multiple COPY statements (CDATED, CBANKDAT, CHELPD01, CBANKD03, CABENDD, CHELPX01)
Service charge banding logic with tiered balance thresholds
GO TO used for screen navigation (COMMON-RETURN pattern)
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL - uses Micro Focus CICS emulation via copybooks
